title: DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, December 3, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, December 3, 3rd, Merck (MRK), Pfizer (PFE) and Walgreens (WBA). Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
 up +433 points.
Friday the Dow was up +199.62 (+0.79%) at 25,538.46.
 +3.31%.
There were 24 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Intel (INTC) +3.38%, Coca Cola (KO) +2.90% and Home Depot (HD) +2.65%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) -2.13%, Disney (DIS) -0.96% and Apple (AAPL) -0.54%.
Caterpillar (CAT +4.18%) was upgraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Neutral’ at Bank of America/Merrill Lynch with a price target of $163.
U.S. stocks are poised to rally after the U.S. and China called a truce to their trade war over the weekend, triggering relief buying of perceived riskier assets such as equities. Oil prices climbed nearly 5%, while the dollar tumbled.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended eight-tenths of a cent at $2.459
